notes.title: Patch notes for version 1.2
notes.content:
Hi Everyone here are the new patch notes:

Added new Fruits.

Added a new languages(Russia, Spanish, German) these can be changed on the settings menu.

Added a new Tag System for fruits called Ascended.

Ascended Fruits can be obtained by crafting with 10 Ascended Fruits Bits, you have a small chance of getting these Bits every time you Chop a Fruit.

Thanks for your support and have fun.

notes.title: New Items / Compensation Item / Info Panel
notes.content:
Hi Everyone.

With the inventory issue now resolve I'm glad to announce the first patch of the game:

Added 2 new Unique rarity fruits one is a design made by a community member.

Added 1 Limited promotional item as compensation for the inventory issue, you will get 1 item when you open the game with the new update.

Added a Info panel where it says how the game in general works also it has information on the percentages for each drop and also how many bits you get from each rarity.

I'm already planning what else to add to the game like: More languages, Linux/Mac support, a panel where you can see exactly what dropped and on what time.

Thank you all if you have any feedback or design ideas for fruits leave it on the discord serve: Link
